answers.goal: My goal is to become a writer, director, and producer who creates stories that have a lasting social and cultural impact. Beyond making films, I want to create work that brings people together, encourages empathy, and gives different voices and experiences a place to be seen and heard.
answers.drew: Storytelling has always been part of my life. Growing up, my family shared stories constantly, and watching films together every weekend became a tradition. That naturally led me to directing because I didn’t just want to experience stories—I wanted to create them. I enjoy the challenge of turning ideas into films and collaborating with others to bring those stories to life.
answers.seeking: I’m open to connecting with anyone who shares a passion for storytelling, whether they’re established in the industry or just beginning their journey. I’m especially interested in meeting directors, writers, producers, PAs, cinematographers, and other filmmakers, but I believe meaningful collaborations can come from unexpected places.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration starts with the people around me—my family, friends, and creative collaborators—because many of my stories come from real experiences and conversations. As a filmmaker, I’m also inspired by directors like John Singleton, Spike Lee, Ryan Coogler, Guillermo del Toro, and Alejandro G. Iñárritu. Beyond film, I draw inspiration from artists across different mediums, from musicians like JAY-Z to painters like Claude Monet
